name: (The NUKE)Fireworks
desc:
Welcome to Fireworks

This game is a firework simulator where you:
🎇 Unlock new fireworks
💵 Earn money from your launches
🎆 Create bigger and better firework show

This game contains flashing lights and loud sounds. Exploiters, please don’t ruin the experience for others. Please report any bug you find.

I update this game sometimes and yes I know I’m a bad developer but I try. It would mean a lot if you:
